command.piston_depth.malilib_required: Install MaLiLib to open the settings screen.
config.piston_depth.title: TickWeave Settings
config.piston_depth.comment.enabled: Show piston depth only while ticks are frozen.
config.piston_depth.comment.hudScale: Multiplier for the entire event list. Range 0.5–3.0.
config.piston_depth.comment.hudX: Left edge of the event list in screen pixels.
config.piston_depth.comment.hudY: Top edge of the event list in screen pixels.
config.piston_depth.comment.pistonNumber: World label size for piston order #1, #2, etc.
config.piston_depth.comment.detailScale: World label size for depth, produced child events, 0t outputs, and component names.
config.piston_depth.comment.wireScale: World label size for wire depth and power.
config.piston_depth.comment.renderDistan: Maximum camera distance for labels, in blocks.
config.piston_depth.comment.titleColor: Text color of the HUD title, in ARGB.
config.piston_depth.comment.textColor: Text color of the tick summary, in ARGB.
config.piston_depth.comment.mutedColor: Color of HUD help and unassigned wires, in ARGB.
config.piston_depth.comment.backgroundCo: Background color of the event list, including opacity.
config.piston_depth.comment.triggerArrow: Color of arrows from a redstone wire to its triggered event.
config.piston_depth.comment.toggleKey: Press to enable or disable depth visualization.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor1: Color for depth D1; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor2: Color for depth D2; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor3: Color for depth D3; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor4: Color for depth D4; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor5: Color for depth D5; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.depthColor6: Color for depth D6; repeats every six depths.
config.piston_depth.comment.worldTextSca: Scales all in-world labels: piston numbers, event details and redstone wires. HUD has a separate scale.
config.piston_depth.comment.showPistonEv: Draw piston order, depth labels, and event arrows in the world and HUD.
config.piston_depth.comment.showWireUpda: Draw observed redstone wire power and depth labels.
